note: Effects (not conditions): states and spell effects. rounds = combat rounds it lasts, minutes = game-clock minutes it lasts (either or both; 0 = no limit of that kind). concentration true = it ends when its caster stops concentrating. endsOn = what the DM must watch for and end it with removeCondition. trigger = what the table enforces by itself: harms (its holder harms another creature), idle-round (a round with no attack and no damage taken), target-down (the creature carrying it drops to 0 hit points); dm = only the DM can see it end.

concentrating.label: Concentrating
concentrating.rule: Holding a spell: a hit forces a Constitution save (DC 10 or half the damage).
concentrating.ends: A failed save, being incapacitated or killed, casting another concentration spell, or ending it.

surprised.label: Surprised
surprised.rule: Can't move, act or react on its first turn.
surprised.ends: The end of its first turn.
surprised.endsOn: the table clears it when that turn ends

disengaged.label: Disengaged
disengaged.rule: Its movement this turn does not provoke opportunity attacks.

sanctuary.label: Sanctuary
sanctuary.rule: Anyone who targets it with an attack or a harmful spell makes a Wisdom save first; on a failure they pick another target or lose the attack or spell. Area effects ignore it.
sanctuary.ends: It attacks, or casts a spell that harms another creature; or 1 minute passes.
sanctuary.endsOn: the warded creature makes an attack or casts a spell that harms another creature

bless.label: Bless
bless.rule: Adds 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws (up to three creatures).

bane.label: Bane
bane.rule: Subtracts 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws (up to three creatures).

mage armor.label: Mage armor
mage armor.rule: Armor Class 13 + Dexterity modifier while unarmored.
mage armor.ends: 8 hours pass, or it dons armor.

haste.label: Haste
haste.rule: Speed doubled, +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and one extra action each turn: only Attack (one weapon attack), Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object.
haste.ends: Concentration ends or 1 minute passes. When it ends the creature is lethargic: it can't move or take actions until after its next turn.

lethargic.label: Lethargic
lethargic.rule: Haste has ended: it can't move or take actions until after its next turn.
lethargic.ends: The end of its next turn.
lethargic.endsOn: the table clears it when its next turn ends

slow.label: Slow
slow.rule: Speed halved, -2 AC and Dexterity saving throws, no reactions. On its turn it can take an action or a bonus action, not both, and only one attack on its action. A 1-action spell on a d20 of 11 or higher takes effect only on its next turn.
slow.ends: It succeeds on a Wisdom save at the end of a turn, concentration ends or 1 minute passes.
slow.endsOn: the creature succeeds on a Wisdom saving throw at the end of one of its turns

hex.label: Hex
hex.rule: Takes extra 1d6 necrotic damage from the caster's attacks; disadvantage on one chosen ability's checks.
hex.ends: Concentration ends or the time runs out (1 to 24 hours).
hex.endsOn: the cursed creature drops to 0 hit points (the curse can move to a new target)

hunter's mark.label: Hunter's mark
hunter's mark.rule: Takes extra 1d6 damage from the ranger's weapon attacks; the ranger tracks it easily.
hunter's mark.ends: Concentration ends or the time runs out (1 to 24 hours).
hunter's mark.endsOn: the marked creature drops to 0 hit points (the mark can move to a new target)

rage.label: Rage
rage.rule: Advantage on Strength checks and saves, bonus damage, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing; cannot cast spells or concentrate.
rage.ends: Its turn passes with no attack made or damage taken, it falls unconscious, or 1 minute passes.
rage.endsOn: a whole round passes in which the raging creature neither attacks a hostile creature nor takes damage

fly.label: Fly
fly.rule: A flying speed of 60 ft. It stays up if it is knocked prone or held (the spell holds it aloft), and ignores difficult terrain and low fences while flying; the height is set with elevate.
fly.ends: Concentration ends or 10 minutes pass: the creature falls (1d6 bludgeoning per 10 ft, at most 20d6, lands prone) unless it can stop itself.

guidance.label: Guidance
guidance.ends: Concentration ends, 1 minute passes, or the bonus is used.
guidance.endsOn: the 1d4 is used on an ability check

aid.label: Aid
aid.rule: Hit point maximum and current hit points rise by 5 (more at higher levels).
